ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 70% high-intensity (white) pixels on internal lobe surfaces against 30% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated at margins and central meridian.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions on both lobes; a solid black central column extending from the peduncle; continuous black pigmentation along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; two distinct isolated circular black focal points located in the lower-medial region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped depression; interior angle estimated at approximately 62 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 12-15% of the vertical fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; notable larger pixel-depth indentations located on the inner-half of the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edges curving upward toward sharp, tapered distal tips; the trailing edge follows a complex sigmoidal curve from notch to tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white pixel clusters indicating barnacle colonization localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; pair of circular dark-pigmented 'rosettes' on the lower-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct set of 4-5 sub-parallel dark linear streaks (rake marks) oriented diagonally in the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe; several shorter vertical linear disruptions on the lower-left lobe boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular calcified-intensity growth/encrustation at the distal tips; no visible amputations or major structural trauma to the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'double-dot' pigmentation focal point on the right lobe; fine black speckling scattered across the primarily white central region of the left lobe.
